summary: A railway valve operator allegedly lured a passenger with a confirmed ticket promise and raped her. The railway administration dismissed the employee from service and withheld his pension benefits.
title: Railway employee dismissed after passenger rape allegation
verification_note: The source describes a genuine case of rape involving a railway employee and a passenger.

summary: Six men allegedly assaulted a woman and her friend before gangraping her in Cuttack district. Police have registered a case and are searching for the accused.
title: Police register case after woman gangraped by six men in Cuttack
verification_note: The source confirms a gangrape case was reported and registered by the police in Cuttack, Odisha.
